newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine value of production up in May.
newsitem.headline: Philippine value of production up in May.

text.p: The Philippine annual value of production index rose 0.5 percent in May, while the volume of production index fell 0.5 percent, the National Statistics Office said on Monday.
On a month-on-month comparison, the value of production index slipped by 0.8 percent to 438.2 from 441.9 last April.
The volume of production index likewise decreased by 0.8 percent to 147.4 from 148.6 in April.
The monthly indices are aimed at providing flash indicators on the performance of key manufacturing enterprises in Manila.
Among the biggest gainers in terms of value were manufacturers of electrical machinery, which went up 33.5 percent from the year-ago level, and basic metals, up 22.3 percent.
Among the biggest losers in terms of value were textile manufacturers which registered a 22.6 percent decline from the year-ago level, and transport equipment, down 18.7 percent.
In terms of volume, the biggest gainer was the base metal industry, which gained 35.0 percent, while the biggest loser was the paper industry, which posted a 12.3 percent decline.
